blocks.text: Keep your favorite TIKI Brand torches burning bright with TIKI Brand Citronella Scented Torch Fuel. Now in an Easy Pour bottle for fewer spills and less mess. Ideal for use with TIKI Brand torches and table torches, this citronella scented torch fuel helps set the mood, adding a sense of fun and ambiance to any backyard or patio. One 128-ounce Easy Pour bottle can fill ten 12-ounce torch fuel canisters.

items.label: CITRONELLA SCENTED TORCH FUEL
items.value: Infused with citronella and lemongrass oils, this premium torch fuel enhances your outdoor ambiance while keeping your torches burning bright. Now available in an Easy Pour Bottle for a mess-free fill.

items.label: EASY-TO-USE POUR SPOUT
items.value: Designed for convenience, the Easy Pour bottle allows for quick, spill-free refills. One 128 oz bottle fills up to ten 12 oz canisters. For best performance, pair with TIKI Wide Mouth Torch Fuel Canisters.

items.label: ENHANCE YOUR OUTDOOR SPACE
items.value: Create a warm, inviting atmosphere with long-lasting torch fuel, perfect for illuminating patios, gardens, backyards, and outdoor gatherings.

items.label: INNOVATIVE OUTDOOR LIGHTING
items.value: TIKI continues to lead in stylish outdoor lighting solutions, offering a range of high-quality torches, table torches, and citronella candle buckets.

items.label: TRUSTED FOR OVER 60 YEARS
items.value: TIKI Brand has been a leader in outdoor lighting and décor, providing premium torches, torch fuel, candles, wicks, stakes, and accessories to elevate your backyard experience.
